Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (November 30, 2023) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation, Doc3516672057 Description: For refractory maintenance for incinerators at the Highland Creek Treatment Plant for the City of Toronto’s Water Division. The term of the Contract is to be for a period of two (2) years from the date of award, with an option in favour of the City to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions for an additional term of up to three (3) additional separate one (1) year periods at the sole discretion of the City and subject to budget approval.
